sentences.en: The prices of Japanese automobiles are still comparatively high.
sentences.zh: 日本汽车的价格仍然相对较高。

sentences.en: There's a comparatively large cinema complex inside the mall.
sentences.zh: 商场里有一个相对较大的电影院综合体。

sentences.en: American senior citizens are comparatively well-off.
sentences.zh: 美国老年人相对较为富裕。

senses.zh: 对比地；相对地 - 比较地；有点，稍微
